rule: one row per item of the udv_v1 sample whose udv_v2 evidence is moved under the relation rules of the inheritance section: the same sampled opinion, shown with its udv_v2 evidence, context and link; the rows are put in a new random order and get new item ids, and the udv_v1 item id and relation are kept in the key only

inheritance.declaration: Declared before any row of the udv_v2 supplementary sheet was judged. utils.udv_v2_analysis supplement-sheet copies this section into the supplementary annotation_key.json, and score-annotation refuses a key whose copy differs from this section.

relation_rules.same: the udv_v2 evidence has the start_char, end_char and speaker_turn of the udv_v1 evidence
relation_rules.superset: same speaker_turn, udv_v2 start_char <= udv_v1 start_char and udv_v2 end_char >= udv_v1 end_char, not same: the udv_v2 passage holds the whole udv_v1 passage and adds text of the same turn
relation_rules.moved: any other case: another turn, a udv_v2 passage that leaves out part of the udv_v1 passage, or evidence in one run only
relation_rules.no_evidence: no evidence in either run (the pessoa_falou items); the item keeps its udv_v1 label, as in the annotation plan

inheritance.multi_udv_rule: an item is moved if any of its UDVs is moved, same if every UDV is same, no_evidence if every UDV is no_evidence, superset otherwise
inheritance.inheritance_rule: an item whose relation is in inherit_relations, or no_evidence, keeps its udv_v1 human label for udv_v2; only the moved items get a row in the supplementary sheet
inheritance.label_independence: the relation is computed from the udv_v1 and udv_v2 offsets and speaker turns only; no human label is read to decide which items are inherited
inheritance.justification: the text added to a superset passage belongs to the same speaker turn, so the text that supported a udv_v1 passage judged correta is still in the udv_v2 passage, and a passage judged parcial or incorreta can only keep or improve its support when text of the same speaker is added
inheritance.consequence: the udv_v2 precision is conservative with respect to the superset items judged parcial or incorreta in udv_v1, whose udv_v2 label could be better than the inherited one
inheritance.assumption: adding a sentence of the same speaker turn does not turn a passage that supports the statement into one that does not
inheritance.sensitivity_rule: the report also gives the precision with the superset items counted only when their udv_v1 label is correta (the others are left out of the denominator), next to the precision with every superset item inherited

criteria.declaration: Declared before any human judgment of this sample exists. The criteria are copied into annotation_key.json when the sample is drawn, and the precision report flags any later change. PASS requires the Wilson lower bound of the stated metric, at the report confidence level, to reach min_wilson_lower on the stated stratum.

blinding.row_order: random permutation (seed stream row_order); item ids follow the row order
known_leaks: a direct_quote item can be recognized when the afirmacao holds a quotation whose words reappear in trecho

a semantic_with_short_quote item is recognizable in the same way: this support type is assigned only when a quote prefix of the afirmacao is found in the sentence that becomes trecho, so the quoted words reappear in trecho; semantic_similarity items (the semantic_match_high and semantic_match_weak strata) show the cue only by coincidence, so only high against weak stays blind
pessoa_falou rows are recognizable by their question, which is asked only of the speaker_check stratum

quote_cue.definition: quote_cue_in_trecho is true when a quotation extracted from afirmacao (udv_pipeline.extract_quotes) has a prefix of 10, 6, 4 or 3 words (udv_pipeline.quote_prefixes) that udv_pipeline.quote_prefix_pattern finds in trecho; it is stored per item in the key only and the precision report splits each evidence stratum by it
